title: Invoice intake for a bookkeeping firm
audience: A small bookkeeping firm that retypes supplier invoices from email into a spreadsheet every week.
build: An automation that reads supplier invoices arriving as PDF attachments and writes one row per invoice to a spreadsheet: supplier, invoice number, date, net, tax and total.
data: Fifty made-up supplier invoices as PDFs, three of them duplicates, in a shared folder.
handIn: A link to the running automation, the spreadsheet it filled, and a short demo video.
doneWhen: All 50 sample invoices are read into the sheet
A duplicate invoice is flagged and not entered twice
An invoice that cannot be read is listed for a person to check
followOn: Posting the approved rows to the firm's accounting system, with an approval step.
